html_source: Photograph of unknown date showing a large carriage pulled up before the Shelbourne and one of the statues that greeted visitors: two Nubian princesses, and two fettered Nubian slave girls, cast by the studio of M. M. Barbezet of Paris. Source: www.marriott.com.
